data.name: Hemanta
data.gender_notes: Hemanta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hemant' meaning 'autumn' or 'dark'. It is often associated with the wisdom and knowledge gained during this season. The name Hemanta signifies the end of the monsoon season and the beginning of the winter season, a time of introspection and preparation for the future. The name Hemanta carries the meaning “Cold, Dark, Sunless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Hemanta usually hope their child will grow to embody cold, dark, sunless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child born during the autumn season, signifying the deep wisdom and knowledge that comes with the changing of the seasons. It is believed that the energy of the autumn season can influence a child's intellectual and emotional growth, making it an ideal name for a child with a strong intellect and a deep connection to spirituality.
data.etymology: Hemanta belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cold, Dark, Sunless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemanta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

He wrote several commentaries on various Sanskrit texts and is considered a major figure in the development of the Sanskrit language.
